Stretched 10.9 ATR -- real risk of a pullback or pause in Asia before continuing. The EMA20/50/POC cluster 29505-29525 is the level to watch: a pullback with a confirmed bullish rejection confirms continuation, losing 29317.75 puts the thesis in question.

GC.en: 2nd session of the breakout, new high 4558.5 but with the move's first real (late) pullback, closing at 4520.30. Stretched 7.3 ATR with the day at 122% of budget. The 4479-4497 discount zone is the missing confirmation: if Asia tags it with a bullish rejection, the 2-day breakout gets validated with force; if it retakes the high with no correction, it stays pure over-extension.

The VAH/EMA20/50 cluster 53724-53767 is the clean entry if the pullback comes; the weekly high 53862 is the real resistance to watch if Asia tests it directly with no correction.
